sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): 'Quality Checks' row 28 (#27 no_criterion_grades_the_unrequired) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 28 annotation (Mukesh: login is a house default, not 'unrequired'); all internal annotations scanned
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (full; 'No hidden requirements', 'Coverage has two directions')
evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for all 2 gate, 40 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria against instruction.md and hireops_rules.md. Every graded demand traces to a public line or a professional default. Gates: sign-in is the house default (SKILL.md:63; Internal sheet row 28); UI job/candidate creation follows rules sec.2 ('Only a recruiter opens a job', 'A recruiter adds a candidate'). Functional: hro_job_open (title; places whole 1-50 so 0/51/2.5 refused; manager from HM accounts: rules sec.2); hro_add_candidate (bottom of Applied: rules sec.2); hro_add_email_rules (field-level refusal, typed text kept, case-insensitive duplicate, same email on another job accepted: rules sec.2); hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_reason/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen (rules sec.3 'Moving a card'; undo of reopening restores the reason per 'Undo ... restores a rejection reason that the move removed'); hro_arrive_bottom/hro_reorder ('Order inside a stage'); hro_interview_full/_reorder_free/hro_undo_full ('Interview places'; Undo 'or if it would overfill Interview'); hro_refused_put_back ('Shown at once, put back if refused ... keyboard focus stays on that card's controls'; a pre-send UI refusal is explicitly accepted); hro_mgr_* ('Who may move what', 'Everything else is refused for them'); hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_anonymous (rules sec.1 401/403/404); hro_stale_refused ('Two people at once'; does not require status 409 or exact wording); hro_bulk_* ('Moving several together'; expected orders Y,W,X and A2,V re-derived by tracing protocol B); hro_undo_* ('Undo' incl. 'Adding a note does not count', once only, superseded by a later move); hro_activity/_refusals (rules sec.4 incl. re-orderings, undos, reasons, per-job filter, newest first; one combined multi-move line accepted); hro_notes ('Internal notes'); 15-second live rows (instruction para 3; rules sec.5); hro_msg_compose ('Messages'); hro_thread_latest/_earlier ('Long conversations', 30 per page, count to come); hro_unread_counts/_scrolled_up/hro_seen ('Unread', 'Seen', observer never counts); hro_thread_access (rules sec.6; Noor answered not-found per rules sec.1 'so they cannot learn that it does'); hro_drafts (instruction para 4; 'Drafts'); hro_candidate_view/_private/_linked (rules sec.7 wording table and forbidden-data list; sec.2 email linking); hro_restart (instruction para 6 'keep new work across restarts', load once). Polish: hro_pol_live_board/_live_thread (rules sec.5 preserve typed text, focus, open card, scroll; at-newest arrival 'is shown'); hro_pol_earlier_place ('the message that was at the top of the view stays where it was'); hro_pol_failed_send ('A message that could not be sent stays in the box, and the person is told it was not sent'); hro_pol_session_resume ('Drafts': sign-in prompt 'at the latest on the next action that needs the server'; others see none; note drafts 'kept for that person on that browser until it is saved'). Visual likert rows grade generic desktop craft and state 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice' and 'No phone layout or theme switching is required' (visual/prompt.md:14), matching instruction para 5. No criterion requires routes, selectors, labels, colours, exact refusal text, HTTP 409, a particular scroll container, or drag; functional/prompt.md:15 says 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording' and hiding refused controls is optional throughout. Seed-dependent expectations verified in seed_data.json: Lena APP-301 has 3 messages with read_count 2 => 1 unread (hro_unread_counts); Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist/Ade Bello/Marco Rossi (positions 1-3), Screen Priya Nair/Samuel Ortiz, Noor APP-101 in Interview with note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (hro_restart, protocol Z); APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context). Conforming alternatives considered and found to pass: button plus drag UI; disabled forward control with visible 'Interview full' reason and focus on the card; one combined Activity line for a multi-card move; server-side draft storage; polling/SSE/socket updates; a generic 403 body for observer replays (criteria only say refused). The seeded APP-301 'rejection_reason': null is not graded anywhere. Latent P3 wording observations, not defects (no false-fail expected from a reasonable judge): (a) hro_add_candidate 'The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' effectively requires the source in card details; justified as the professional default for the card-details view rules sec.3 requires. (b) hro_reopen 'after reopening the reason is gone' could be misread if the judge sees the reason in the immutable rejection Activity line (rules sec.4 'Entries are never edited'); the criterion context is the card. (c) hro_activity's parenthetical '(notes and messages are not recorded in Activity ...)' could read as a prohibition, but its fail list does not penalise extra note lines. (d) hro_pol_session_resume requires Rafael's drafts to survive his explicit sign-out; supported by rules 'kept for that person on that browser until it is saved' and 'Anyone else who signs in on that browser sees none of them'. Optional hardening: say 'on the card' in hro_reopen and 'recording notes is optional' in hro_activity. Evidence type: source/semantic review only. No configured-judge run on a conforming alternative app was performed by this reviewer and raw-evidence-index.json was not relied on. This implies no Oracle, model or portal score.
